---
name: Actionable Work
about: Track one concrete task with evidence, an owner, and verifiable completion criteria
---

## Goal
What should be completed?

## Evidence and context
Link the authoritative source, existing issue, pull request, or decision. Separate verified facts from assumptions.

## Scope and boundaries
What is included? Note repository/security boundaries and any production or access changes that require separate approval.

## Dependencies
Link blocking work or state that no dependency is known. Do not invent native links when GitHub does not support them in this repository.

## Ownership and review
- Accountable owner (verified): @
- Independent reviewer, if needed (verified): @
- If ownership is unknown, name the decision needed and keep the task blocked rather than assigning by inference.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] State observable completion checks.
- [ ] Link or describe the evidence that will demonstrate each result.

## Priority, status, and estimate
- Priority:
- Status:
- Estimated target date (YYYY-MM-DD):
- Estimate basis and dependencies:
- Commitment status: estimate only / confirmed commitment

Keep titles concise, descriptive, and in Title Case. Do not add workflow prefixes or ticket identifiers unless repository-specific rules require them. Do not include credentials, private keys, personal data, or restricted operational details.
